title: KEPCO Breach, Aeroméxico Records, Defense Contractor Leak, RCS Zero-Day, Frappe RCE, VPN Access Auction, and Eclipse RaaS
content_md: The SOCRadar Dark Web Team observed several notable underground posts this week. KEPCO confirmed a breach affecting 1.52 million users while a forum actor advertised a far larger dataset, and a seller listed 22 million alleged Aeroméxico records. Other posts include a claimed 180 TB defense-industry leak, two zero-day exploit sales, a 27-organization VPN access auction, and a new ransomware-as-a-service platform. KEPCO Confirms Breach of 1.52 Million Users as Alleged 560 Million-Record Sale is Advertised South Korea’s state-owned utility Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) has confirmed a data breach affecting about 1.52 million users: 650,487 users of its KEPCO ON customer platform and 869,761 users of its SRM procurement system. The KEPCO ON exposure includes names, resident registration numbers, bank account details, credit card information and billing records. KEPCO says it blocked access from external IP addresses, suspended the affected services and opened an investigation with the National Intelligence Service and outside experts.
